notes.title: v1.4.0 has Arrived
notes.notes:
v1.4.0 of A Business Power has been completed.

Food Processing Update:
Now there are Factories and Products related to Food.

Here are some new Features:
-Factory Popups: Factory warnings and problems will now be shown on top of the Building.
-7 Buildings in Food Processing Line.
-7 new Products in Food Processing Line.
-Fixed Settings and Problems related to Saving.
-Added Info in Building Screens for its hotkeys.
-Bug Fixes.

Regular Updates are still Postponed until STAY is Released. The Release Date of STAY is still going To Be Announced. View our [url=https://www.facebook.com/SADGames2019/]Facebook Page[/url] for more updates regarding STAY and other Games.
